description: Creates an Open Graph image, the card shown when a link is shared, from a title and an optional subtitle, site label and logo. Returns a link valid for seven days and the image itself.

accent.description: Accent colour as six hex digits.

bg.description: Background colour as six hex digits, overriding the theme.

logo.description: Public URL of a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG logo, up to 512 KB.

site.description: Short label shown at the bottom, for example your domain, up to 60 characters.

template.description: `card` (accent bar and logo), `minimal` (centred) or `split` (text beside an accent panel).

name: generate_social_image
title: Generate a social card image
